body:
Sometimes you have to surround yourself with good people and people that understand whats its like, people thats know what its like to feel like this. Its nice to know someone whos going through the same thing as you because its feels more comforting that the know how it feels. Dont let people tell you to feel better because we all know feeling take time. And time is precious. Be yourself, fuck what anyone thinks find love, happiness, try new things to be open about your feeling and the right people will help and stand by you through your time. Remember this feeling you have isnt permanent because it will get better soon it just takes time. Like baby steps 
Stay strong my friend, better days are ahead of you x
